drawer.$description: Modal edge panel — unlike Popover, blocks interaction with the rest of the page while open (that's what makes it a true dialog, not a floating panel). Uses the native <dialog> element with showModal(): free focus-trap, free Escape-to-close, free ::backdrop, top-layer rendering with no z-index needed. Kept as a token file/build script separate from Modal per explicit prior decision, even though both are '<dialog> with showModal()' underneath — their sizing/positioning/radius differ enough (edge-attached vs. free-floating centered) to earn their own files rather than a shared one with position variants. No outer border — 3 of its 4 edges sit flush against the viewport boundary (no page visible around them to define an edge against), and shadow.md + the backdrop scrim already read as a distinct raised layer; a border would be redundant. radius: none for the same flush-edge reason (Modal, which floats free on all sides, does get one). Single fixed width for the 'right'/'left' placements (dim.80, 320px) — a settings/detail-view panel doesn't need a size grid the way Input does. Animated open/close via native CSS (@starting-style + transitions on transform/::backdrop, allow-discrete) — no JS animation library. Header and footer are both optional composition, same as Card — a Drawer can be body-only. The close button and footer actions are real interactive elements with their own hover/active/focus states (the same fill.neutral/fill.neutralHover/fill.neutralActive/fill.primary/fill.primaryHover recipe Button itself uses), not unstyled placeholders — anything a user can click deserves real states, doc demo or not.

width.$description: 320px — used by the left/right placements. The bottom placement ignores this and uses 100% width with a max-height cap instead.

padding.$description: 24px — one step more generous than Popover's 16px, proportionate to Drawer being a full modal panel, not a small anchored one.

gap.$description: 12px — internal flex gap within the header row (title-to-close-button) and footer row (button-to-button). Section-to-section spacing (header-to-body, body-to-footer) comes from each section having its own full padding, not from this gap — every section is a full-width band with its own padding.default of 24px, so the divider between them spans the whole drawer width instead of sitting inset (a header/footer border scoped to a single shared-padding wrapper looked wrong once built — a divider that stops short of the edges reads as misaligned on a big edge-attached panel, unlike Card's small inset dividers, which are fine at that scale).

transitionDuration.$description: Literal, not a token — no duration scale exists in this system yet (same 'literal, not invented' precedent as Tooltip's showDelay).

divider.$description: Header/footer section dividers — internal only, the drawer's own outer edge has no border (see $description).
